chunks: Muḥammad ibn Abī Ḥamzah narrated from Isḥāq ibn ʿAmmār, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
If an absent man wants to divorce his wife, he should leave her for one month.

key_terms.ٱلْغَائِبُ: the absent man, meaning a husband who is away

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if an absent man wants to divorce his wife?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the divorce of a wife by a husband who is absent. It states that if the absent husband intends to divorce her, he should leave the matter for one month, indicating a specific waiting condition in this circumstance.
